user.title: Connect to Fluvigil
user.description: Create an API key in your Fluvigil account under Account → API keys.

station.title: Find a gauge
station.description: Search by gauge or water body, e.g. "Köln" or "Rhein".

reauth_confirm.title: Replace the API key
reauth_confirm.description: Fluvigil no longer accepts the API key. Create a new one in your Fluvigil account under Account → API keys. It replaces the old key for every gauge that used it.

error.invalid_auth: That API key was not accepted. Check it in your Fluvigil account under Account → API keys.
error.cannot_connect: Fluvigil could not be reached. Check the server URL and your connection.
error.rate_limited: The hourly request budget of your tier is used up. Try again later.
error.no_value: Fluvigil currently provides no value for this gauge.

abort.already_configured: That gauge is already set up.
